create_associative_memory_component: create an AssociativeMemory component backed by an associative memory bank for an agent
create_list_memory_component: create a ListMemory component that maintains a simple list of string memories
retrieve_associative_memories: retrieve memories most closely matching a query using cosine similarity from an associative memory bank
retrieve_recent_memories: retrieve the most recent memories from a memory bank sorted by recency
scan_memories_with_selector: scan memories using a selector function to filter and retrieve matching memories
